metadata.division: DIVISION 1-1-4. RELATIONSHIP TO OTHER CODES, ORDINANCES, AND REGULATIONS

content.title: 1-1-4-1. Conflict with State or Federal Regulations.
content.summary: If the provisions of this Code are inconsistent with those of the state or federal government, the provisions of this Code will control, to the extent permitted by law.
